releases.name: Backpack Inspector
releases.summary:
Fantasy customs officer simulator. Decide the fate of the heroes who want to get into the kingdom, on whose guard you stand. Check their backpacks for forbidden artifacts, stolen items, and contraband.

Be watchful, for the glory of the crown!

releases.name: Vibe City Islands Architect
releases.summary: The mayor has given you a budget; people need housing, jobs, parks. The city needs a tourism boost, now! It's actually a chill game.. 10 gangs, each with their own radio station. Build for the city, or for your favourite gang.......... You are the architect.

releases.name: Color Fear
releases.summary:
This is a horror game unlike any other. Explore the deepest fears that come from The Color Fun Coloring Show.

Today on The Color Fun Coloring Show they want viewers to help them find out who is breaking into their house. Each new Fear that breaks in will hunt you down! All the show wants to know is what color they show you!

releases.name: Breathedge 2
releases.summary:
Sent on a reckless mission, you find yourself in outer space filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new breathtaking survival game.

Breathedge 2 is an ironic retro-futuristic space survival game that continues the story of the Man facing epic intergalactic problems. Together with your irreplaceable companions, try to put an end to the Breathedge Corporation without dying or going crazy in the process.

releases.name: EONA
releases.summary:
Play as Eona, a young girl cursed through both her soul and her puppet. Do your best to escape this dark castle with the Puppeteer’s Cross - a legendary artifact you stole. It is your only means of defense, and the only thing that can save your sick mother.

Fail, and you will suffer the same fate as countless innocent souls before you.

releases.name: POTENTIAL MAN
releases.summary: POTENTIAL MAN is a role-playing experience where you must navigate the whims and woes of a humble seed. This wacky story features fully hand-drawn visuals, zany characters, and a classic JRPG-styled soundtrack to boot. Are you ready to achieve your true potential?

releases.name: Gooober Acres
releases.summary: Farm, Mine, and Eliminate Gooobers. Interact with Villagers to Trade, Craft, and do Quests. Play alone or with Friends.

releases.name: Starship Kepler
releases.summary: Starship Kepler is an intense arcade shooter that encourages movement and variety. You play as a lost-in-space starship: Kepler, contending with an endless barrage of geometric shapes. Combine elements to upgrade your weapon, explore anomalies, survive as long as you can.

releases.name: Spright
releases.summary: Forge your path in Crownless, an indie-fantasy MMORPG with many roads to explore. Discover dangerous worlds, experience meaningful progression, and engage with the community along your journey!
